Location management and creation

List locations the caller has access to

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations

Returns locations the caller has access to. Supports a jsonb-containment filter on locations.metadata so a caller who has previously stamped a location with their own external identifier (e.g. POS or integration ID) can look that location up directly — no need to know Karma's internal location ID.

Filtering on metadata accepts either form:

  • ?metadata={"someKey":"value"} — JSON-encoded object
  • ?metadata.someKey=value — dotted shorthand, one key per query param

Combine with search (matches on name, city, address) and standard pagination.

Permissions: 🔵 locations.read

List locations the caller has access to › query Parameters

search
​string

Search on name, city, or address

page
​integer · min: 1
Default: 1
limit
​integer · min: 1 · max: 200
Default: 50
metadata
​string

JSON-encoded jsonb-containment filter on locations.metadata. Example: ?metadata={"someKey":"value"}. The dotted shorthand ?metadata.someKey=value is also accepted.

Create a new location

POST
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations

Create a new location for the merchant. The location will be linked to the same company as the user's current active location.

Hierarchy Options:

  • Standalone (default): Independent location with no parent
  • Parent: Set isRootCompany: true to mark as a parent/root location
  • Child: Provide parentLocationId to create as a child of another location

Payout Account: A payout account will be created with the specified PSP (STRIPE or ADYEN). For Adyen, billingEmail is required.

Required Fields:

  • name: Location name (1-255 characters)
  • address: Street address
  • city: City name
  • country: Country code (e.g., SE, NO)
  • psp: Payment Service Provider (STRIPE or ADYEN)

Permissions: 🟢 locations.create

Get a location by ID

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}

Get detailed information about a specific location, including its feature toggles.

Features: By default, the response includes all available features and their status for this location. Set includeFeatures=false to exclude features from the response.

Response includes:

  • Location details (name, address, timezone, currency, etc.)
  • Feature toggles with enabled status and optional metadata
  • Hierarchy information if applicable

Update location opening hours

PUT
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/hours

Update or create opening hours for a location. This replaces the entire schedule.

Permissions: 🟠 schedules.update

Update location opening hours › path Parameters

locationId
​string · pattern: ^[0-9]+$ · required

Location ID

Update location opening hours › Request Body

​object · required

Opening hours for each day of the week. This is a FULL REPLACE: every PUT deletes all existing rules and re-inserts only what is sent here, so the caller must always send the complete week (and all exceptions). A day omitted from this object is dropped, not left unchanged.

​object[]

List of exceptions to set (replaces all existing exceptions)

Update location settings

PATCH
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/settings

Update settings for a specific location. Supports partial updates - only provided fields will be updated.

Supported fields:

  • phone: Phone number (set to null to clear)
  • website: Website URL (set to null to clear, max 248 chars)
  • description: Location description (set to null to clear, max 1000 chars)
  • pickupInformation: Pickup information text
  • context: Location context JSON (features, configuration, etc.)
  • isItemCommentAllowed: Whether item comments are allowed
  • orderPlacements: Order placement configuration per channel
  • paymentFlow: Default payment flow (open_tab or pay_upfront, set to null to clear)
  • defaultPreparationTimeSeconds: Default preparation time
  • takeawayEnabled: Whether takeaway is enabled
  • autoacceptMinutesBeforePickup: Minutes before pickup for auto-accept
  • pickupTimeEnabled: Whether time slot selection is enabled
  • pickupDaysInAdvanceAllowed: Days in advance for pickup time selection

Permissions: 🟠 locations.update

Get a location's voucher provider and display name

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/voucher-provider

Returns the location's voucher provider type and a ready-to-render display name.

Behavior:

  • voucher_provider='trivec' → providerDisplayName: 'Trivec' (hardcoded, never leaks voucherService)
  • voucher_provider='custom' with valid displayName → providerDisplayName: <settings.displayName>
  • voucher_provider='custom' with displayName containing the forbidden third-party vendor substring (case-insensitive) → providerDisplayName: null
  • No integration_configs row OR voucher_provider IS NULL → { voucherProvider: 'karma', providerDisplayName: null }

Permissions: 🔵 locations.read

Update voucher provider configuration for a location

PUT
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/voucher-provider

Upserts integration_configs.voucher_provider and settings in a single transaction.

Body is a tagged union by provider:

  • { provider: 'karma' } — switch back to native Karma vouchers (no settings)
  • { provider: 'trivec' } — enable Trivec; credentials are provisioned out-of-band, never via merchant PUT (CRED-02)
  • { provider: 'custom', settings: {...} } — configure a custom HTTP voucher provider

Server-side behaviour:

  • Custom provider secrets are AES-256-CBC encrypted server-side; plaintext is expected in the request body over HTTPS.
  • Requests containing the forbidden third-party vendor substring (case-insensitive) in any string value are rejected with 400 before reaching the DB.
  • In-flight voucher reservations or a non-empty DLQ block provider switches with 409 to prevent double-spend.

Test connectivity to the configured Trivec voucher provider

POST
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/{locationId}/voucher-provider/test

Calls Trivec /voucher/services via integrations-service using the currently-saved config.

Behaviour:

  • Persists last_tested_at and last_test_reachable on integration_configs.
  • Non-Trivec providers return 400 INVALID_PROVIDER_FOR_TEST.
  • Does not emit platform_events (D-08).

Get location by slug

GET
https://common-api.karma.life
/api/v1/locations/slug/{slug}

Get comprehensive location information by its URL slug.

Response includes:

  • Location details (name, address, coordinates, contact info)
  • Current sale status and times
  • Opening hours (weekly hours, exceptions, schedule ID)
  • Theme and branding configuration
  • Feature flags and settings (discounts, scan-to-tab, split items, etc.)
  • Loyalty program information
  • Extended waiting time (if set)

This is the primary endpoint for storefront applications to fetch location data. The slug is the URL-friendly identifier for the location (e.g., "joes-pizza").

Webhook: Location operating hours updated

POST
https://common-api.karma.life
/webhook/location.hours.updated

Broadcast when a schedule rule for a location changes — lets storefronts and clients refresh open/closed status.

This is an outbound webhook event. Karma POSTs this payload to the URL you registered via POST /api/v1/webhooks/subscriptions. Your endpoint should respond 2xx within 30 seconds to acknowledge delivery.
